title: Tilt Tag
summary: Tilt a magnet through a 90-second daily obstacle run.
user: People with a phone and three spare minutes who want a tactile browser challenge without an install.
smallest_useful_product: A portrait web game: tilt a magnet to collect targets while avoiding hazards in 90-second runs, with calibration, inversion, seated mode, touch fallback, and a daily seed.
success_measure: At least 70% of first-time players finish calibration and 20% play three or more runs in one session.
